responsibility: Contains the RTL machine-description support for RISC-V atomic and synchronization operations. It defines unspec codes and patterns for fences, atomic loads/stores, AMO fetch/update operations, compare-and-swap, test-and-set, and LR/SC-based subword atomics with memory-model handling, making it the backend’s dedicated description of how GCC atomic primitives map onto the RISC-V A extension and inline subword sequences.
